bugs.title: Folio separator rows included in transaction list (multi-folio CAS)
bugs.rootCause: rawBalCheck/rawMVCheck guard was in v5.262 parseXLS() but dropped in revert to v5.113 base.
bugs.fix: v5.273: Re-added 2-line folio separator check (rawBalCheck==='--' && rawMVCheck==='--') in parseXLS() row loop.

bugs.title: No way to append new XLS transactions without full re-import
bugs.rootCause: appendXLS callback was in v5.262 but dropped. Users had to re-import entire file or add transactions one by one.
bugs.fix: v5.273: appendXLS useCallback re-added. Deduplicates by date|scheme|type|amount key. Button added in Data Management.

bugs.title: No validation of transaction data
bugs.rootCause: runValidation with 6 rules was in v5.262 rebuild but absent in v5.272. Users had no way to spot duplicates or missing NAV.
bugs.fix: v5.273: runValidation (6 rules: future dates, missing amount, no NAV, NAV mismatch >10%, duplicates, missing scheme). Panel with filter/dismiss/re-run in Data Management.

bugs.title: Dashboard KPI hero cards showed ₹ regardless of currency setting
bugs.rootCause: heroStats.pv, heroStats.gain, heroStats.invested, heroStats.net all rendered via INR() in DashboardPage JSX.
bugs.fix: v5.273: All INR() replaced with FMT() globally. Hero cards now respect G_CURRENCY.

bugs.title: FY Summary page monetary values hardcoded in ₹
bugs.rootCause: FYSummaryPage had 19 INR() calls for invested, redeemed, dividends, net flow, portfolio value.

bugs.title: XIRR Review chart tooltips and table used hardcoded ₹
bugs.rootCause: XirrReviewPage and XIRRHistoryChart both used INR(). 5 INR() calls in chart tooltip builder strings.

bugs.title: NPV page values hardcoded in ₹
bugs.rootCause: NpvPage used INR() for NPV display and chart Y-axis.

bugs.title: NAV date not shown in Portfolio Value card
bugs.rootCause: navAsOf()/navDaysStale not yet added. Sub-label hardcoded to 'Current market value'.
bugs.fix: Planned for v5.274: Add navAsOf() function and navDaysStale useMemo in DashboardPage.

bugs.title: Babel blank screen — literal newline in JS string
bugs.rootCause: join('\n') written with real newline inside single-quoted string. Babel: Unterminated string constant.
bugs.fix: v5.272: Changed to join('\\n'). Added automated literal-newline scan before deploy.

bugs.title: Edge Tracking Prevention blocked localStorage → blank screen
bugs.rootCause: Edge blocks localStorage on file:// protocol. Every _store.get() returned null, app stuck in 'loading' state.
bugs.fix: v5.272: _store wrapper tries localStorage, falls back to in-memory Map.

bugs.title: Data never saved or restored across sessions
bugs.rootCause: const _store=(()=>{..._store.set(...)...})() referenced _store during its own initialization (TDZ) so the localStorage test always threw and the in-memory fallback was always used. Nothing was ever written to disk.
bugs.fix: v6.0: rewrote _store to call localStorage.setItem/getItem directly with a separate in-memory fallback flag. Added IndexedDB mirror + debounced save-on-change.

bugs.title: iOS tip script: Unexpected identifier 'div'
bugs.rootCause: this.closest('div') inside a single-quoted innerHTML string terminated the string early.

bugs.title: Google sign-in required a Google Cloud Client ID (API key)
bugs.rootCause: Primary login path depended on a hardcoded OAuth Client ID tied to one Google project — conflicts with open-source/no-key requirement.
bugs.fix: v6.0: email login made primary & fully key-free; Google demoted to optional.

roadmap.desc: Multi-format import, FMT engine, scheme mapping, return-basis everywhere, multi-portfolio compare, sort/filter, email login.
Fixed the critical persistence bug, IndexedDB durability, open-source key-free auth, and the Admin Console with the in-app Feature DB + version + feature flags + settings.
SIP/SWP calculator (F116) + goal-based corpus tracker (F117). Required monthly SIP for a target. Pure client-side maths.
STCG/LTCG summary per FY (F118) from the existing FIFO engine. Browser print-to-PDF report (F125).
Sector allocation (F122), fund overlap (F123), AMC concentration risk (F124) from open AMFI category data.
Help↔Settings cross-links (F115), PWA offline service worker (F128), touch-optimised charts (F129).
Optional sync to a user-run open-source backend (PocketBase / Supabase-self-hosted / CouchDB). Free; the user owns the server. App stays fully usable with zero backend.
Optional portfolio commentary & NL queries (F119-F121) using a key the user supplies. Disabled by default; never required.
